text.description_html:
Mont Hard THY-1195FM2, 95" Full Mortise Continuous Geared Hinge

This 95" long full mortise Continuous Gear Hinge is normally used in new construction and is fastened so as to conceal both leaves. Full Mortise Hinge - The frame leaf is fastened to the door frame jamb. Door leaf is fastened to the door edge.

A Continuous Geared Hinge consists of two full-height, paired, and geared leafs. Each geared leaf rotates evenly from top to bottom, riding on superior Delrin Teflon bearings. The geared leafs and bearings are held together by a full length channel cap. This assembly retains the smooth, clean lines of the door and frame, while easily supporting heavy vertical loads. Mont Hard Continuous Gear Hinges are made of 6063 T6 Aluminum with interlocking extrusions and packaged complete with mounting hardware. The thrust bearings are concealed and self-lubricating for long life. They offer a high degree of security and door edge guard.

Also available: 83" Full Mortise Continuous Geared Hinge for Offset Doors

Specifications for the Global Door Controls Mont Hard THY-1195FM2:

  • Hinge Length: 95"
  • Hinge Material: 6063 T6 Aluminum
  • Number of Bearings: 32
  • Door to Frame Clearance: 5/16"
  • Door Offset: 1/16"
  • Non Handed
  • Maximum Door Height: 7'-10" (95")
  • Hinge Type: Full Mortise Continuous Gear Hinge
  • Template Hole Pattern
  • Packaged with Installation Hardware
  • 10 Year Warranty
  • Mont Hard THY-1195FM2 Dimensional Diagram (PDF)

Sold individually (1 Hinge Set - For 1 Door).
